trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Indexing a tensor with at least one zero-length slice, such as slice(0), especially when combined with non-empty slices or followed by further indexing on the resulting empty tensor.

bug_oracle.description: Indexing a tensor with a zero-length slice may return incorrect results instead of the expected empty tensor or standard empty-slice semantics.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate varied tensor shapes and mutate slice ranges to produce start==stop, empty ranges, and zero-length slice boundaries.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct tensors with dimensions that can become empty under slicing, including small or zero-length dimensions, and use both contiguous and view-based tensors.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Inject slicing constraints that force zero-length output along one or more axes while keeping other axes non-empty.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Apply torch.Tensor.__getitem__ with a zero-length slice, then perform further indexing, reshaping, or reduction operations on the resulting empty tensor.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare resulting tensor shape, dtype, and values against expected empty tensor behavior or explicit empty tensor construction such as torch.empty(0, ...).
